notes: Context ownership becomes VERIFIED only from repository evidence. Identity, Garage, Master and Booking have partial factual inventories against current main; unresolved ownership is kept explicit instead of promoted to canon.

verifiedInvariants: One Account is resolved by phone and linked to one Person; profile activation does not create a second Account.
AuthSession stores current_context_id and session rotation/revocation state.
Contexts are selected only from contexts available to the current Account directly or through active context_members membership.
Effective authorization is calculated by backend capability allow/deny rules for the active Context.
AuthorizationPipeline performs a separate resource-ownership/access check after capability authorization.

Complete migration history for every Identity table

events: vehicle_service_due notification is emitted from vehicle reminder state
verifiedInvariants: The current runtime vehicle record is client_vehicles; the target term GarageVehicle is a domain name, not yet a physical table name.
Vehicle-owned child data is keyed by vehicle_id and access is scoped to an owned/authorized client_vehicles row.
Service orders reference the vehicle through orders.client_vehicle_id; Garage reads those orders but does not own their lifecycle.
Garage write flows in client_cabinet require the vehicles.update capability; read flows use vehicles.read.
Mileage updates cannot decrease the stored mileage and append a vehicle history event when changed.
unverified: All frontend routes and callers for Garage
Whether every vehicle mutation has been migrated from legacy role checks to capability-only authorization

dependencies: Service because master scheduling operates on orders
verifiedInvariants: Master working preferences are persisted separately from Identity Account/Person state.
Scheduling code validates conflicts before moving planned work and rechecks conflicts under transaction/lock during auto-recovery.
Master scheduling operates on an existing order and may update order date/time; this is a cross-domain write and must not be treated as proof that Master owns the Order lifecycle.
Operational scheduling may depend on STO bay availability and tariff capacity guards.

verifiedInvariants: A physical service_bookings store exists and links a booking_key to a calendar_event_id with optional organization, master, resource and related entity references.

Master operational scheduling currently uses master_order_plans keyed one-to-one by order_id, so current booking/scheduling ownership is not cleanly isolated.
